question: After a venomous snakebite on the trail, should you apply a tight tourniquet and cut the wound to suck out the venom?
true_option: No — no tourniquet, no cutting or sucking; keep the person calm and still and get medical help fast
false_option: Yes — a tourniquet plus cutting and suction slows the venom until help arrives

source: CDC venomous snakebite guidance: do NOT apply a tourniquet and do NOT slash the wound or attempt to suck out venom; keep the person calm and still, and seek medical attention as soon as possible.
